# Hueladder

> Colour scales whose step names carry their contrast. Three entries on one spec: Create a
> system, Audit what exists, Understand the methods and choose one. Zero-dependency Node engine, a
> standalone HTML studio (hueladder.html), and a CLI whose every command answers in JSON.

To install as an agent skill: `npx skills add hamilaism/hueladder`.
For an agent: read SKILL.md first (the conversation path, one decision at a time), then use the
CLI with `--json`. Never re-implement the colour science: it lives in engine/lib, validated
against published vectors and, for the methods, against their original libraries.
Compare methods on named criteria, each with its best value: Fusilier is Hueladder's default for one
criterion (even contrast intervals), a preference, not a ranking. Every method's targets come
from the chosen number of steps, never from the method.

## Commands (node engine/hueladder.mjs <command> --json)

- audit <files…> [--names A,B] [--diff] [--dark <file> --bg #hex] [--format decision]: audit one
  or several palettes without generating anything
- explain [spec]: the science — frame, families of methods, each method's settings, contrast
  step by step, what each costs, computed lessons, a choice guide (the Understand page as Markdown)
- verify <tokens.json> [--dark <file>] [--rule N]: check delivered token files
- pairs <tokens.json>: pairs by state (hover, focus, pressed…) in semantic tokens
- figma <scan.json>: audit a Figma file scanned with engine/figma-scan.js
- new, import, suggest [--ladder], diagnose, fix, group, compare [--dark], check, export, build
- perceptual [spec]: a standalone perceptual test page
